Field Guide to Soil Sampling

Soil sampling is the foundation of any nutrient management plan. A representative sample must combine material from many points across the field, taken at a consistent depth and handled carefully to avoid contamination.

Equipment

  • Stainless steel probe or auger
  • Clean plastic bucket
  • Sample bags and a permanent marker

Procedure

  1. Divide the field into uniform zones.
  2. Collect fifteen to twenty cores per zone.
  3. Mix the cores thoroughly and fill one bag per zone.

Label each bag with the field name, the zone and the date. Ship samples within two days and keep them cool and dry in the meantime.

DepthCropInterval
0–15 cmCerealsEvery 3 years
0–30 cmGrasslandEvery 4 years
